integrity: The endpoint characterization and all sharp consequences are proved from the quantified definitions. An exhaustive independent checker verifies every relation for chain sizes at most four. The motivating 2026 preprint was inspected in full text; targeted searches did not locate the finite-chain endpoint normal form or census. One related 2024 bounded-morphism paper was available only through metadata and abstract in the bounded search.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite strict chains and total expansive relations in the forward/backward-confluence sense of the motivating modal-logic source. It does not classify branching frames or preorders with nontrivial clusters.
title: Endpoint normal form for expansive relations between finite strict chains
